title: Easy Malaysian Feta Pasta
description: A flexitarian-friendly Malaysian dish featuring cubed feta cheese and a pasta-water-emulsion, perfect for a lazy Sunday, cooked to perfection on a tava-griddle.
instructions: Bring the water to a boil in a large pot and cook the pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
While the pasta is cooking, heat the olive oil on the tava-griddle over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the tava-griddle and saute until fragrant.
Add the cubed feta cheese to the tava-griddle and cook until it starts to melt and soften.
Add the malaysian curry powder, salt, and black pepper to the tava-griddle and stir to combine.
Drain the cooked pasta and add it to the tava-griddle, stirring to combine with the feta cheese mixture.
Create a pasta-water-emulsion by adding some of the pasta cooking water to the tava-griddle and stirring to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer the mixture for a few minutes until the sauce has thickened slightly.
Garnish with chopped scallions and serve hot.
